title: nwpc-data-client data config (v1 raw file)
description: Field-level schema for RAW v1 (client <= 0.8) config files. v1 files are plain YAML with field-level templates using "{...}" delimiters, so they can be validated directly (e.g. IDE live hints via `# yaml-language-server: $schema=...`). This is a lightweight check only; the authoritative validation is `nwpc_data_client config lint`. v2/v3 raw files are whole-file Go templates and can NOT be validated with JSON Schema.

_config_version.description: Optional for v1 files: a missing field means v1. If present, it must be 1.

file_name.description: Every template action must be either a whitelisted v1 variable action ({.Year}, {.Forecast}, the 4DV/1HR families, or the StartTime/ForecastTime raw objects, optionally piped) or a call to one of the 8 registered functions (functions ARE available in file_name/file_names in v1).

path.description: Whitelisted v1 variables only (optionally piped). In v1 the paths[].path template has NO FuncMap registered (v0.8.1 common/local.go), so actions starting with a function call are forbidden here. Note: this is a lightweight pattern check and cannot reject custom functions appearing mid-pipeline; `config lint` is the authoritative validation.
